activity.notes: Pakistan's National Assembly lists Muhammad Ali Jinnah as the first Governor-General from 15 August 1947 until his death on 11 September 1948. ATLAS uses Dominion of Pakistan rather than the later Islamic Republic of Pakistan because the Governor-Generalship belonged to the 1947-1956 dominion constitutional order.

sources.title: National Assembly of Pakistan - Governor Generals
sources.citation_text: Official National Assembly list gives Jinnah's Governor-General tenure as 15 August 1947 to 11 September 1948.

sources.title: National Assembly of Pakistan - History of Parliament
sources.citation_text: Official parliamentary history records Jinnah being sworn in as the first Governor-General on 15 August 1947.
